items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: We rehearsed all day but Roy and I had worked and Chu had joined the band at Roseland to get the band in shape.

ctx.x: And George Stevenson, a fellow by the name of Thigpen trumpet player, Maddox Pigeon, a good one, too. A very good one. And Max Merritt ... Saxophone section was... I can't remember everybody. That's a long time ago, Stan.
Yeah. Well, this is before the band with Chu Berry and Roy in it?
Well, now that's the segue, '35 to '36. That's a direct segue right there. So, Snack had an idea. He had too many things going. He worked in Roseland, you know.
